description: This file defines the 'Job' interface for scheduled jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework, including job states, lifecycle methods, and job properties.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: An interface representing a scheduled job with lifecycle management methods and properties such as state, ID, name, runtime, scheduling, and priority.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current execution state of the job, such as CREATED, QUEUED, etc.

methods.name: getJobId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the job.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job.

methods.name: getRuntime
methods.description: Provides the duration in milliseconds the job has been running; zero if it has not run.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the job is ready to be queued.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Transitions the job to the created state if there was an issue adding it to the queue.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Transitions the job to the queued state for execution.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time for the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the job, with higher values indicating higher priority.
